description: Comparative performance of rural water supplies during drought - dataset is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by British Geological Survey. Ethiopia experienced severe drought in 2015-16. Many rural communities experienced declines in the performance of their water supply systems. As a result UNICEF commissioned a real-time monitoring and responsive operation and maintenance programme for point source rural water supplies across Central, Northern and Eastern Ethiopia. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher British Geological Survey. Its tags are groundwater, drought, Africa, rural water supply, functionality. The repository dates the deposit 2020; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
